headline: Qualcomm launches new Snapdragon Sound Elite AI audio chip
summary: Qualcomm has launched the Snapdragon Sound Elite Gen 2, a new AI chip for audio wearables that integrates 'micro-power Wi-Fi 6E' to enable lossless streaming without dropouts. Separately, PrismML is bringing its tiny open-weight LLMs to Qualcomm-powered smart glasses, aiming for on-device AI that better uses existing computing power.
